name: calendar_list
description: List calendar entries for a person, a specific day or a date range.

person.description: participant name to filter by, empty for the user themself

date.description: specific day like '7.9.' or 'September 1'; empty uses horizon

until.description: last day of a range (inclusive) like 'September 7'

horizon.description: 'today', 'week' or 'month' when no date is given

name: calendar_find_slot
description: Find common free time slots for a group of persons.

until.description: last day of the search range like 'September 24'; empty with date means one day

days.description: search horizon in days (from today) when no date is given

name: calendar_create
description: Create a calendar entry or all-day absence (vacation, trip).

until.description: last day for multi-day absences like 'august 18'; empty for single day

time.description: time of day like '14:00'; empty for all-day absences

end_time.description: end time of day like '16:00' for explicit time ranges

name: calendar_move
description: Move an existing entry to another day and/or time.

title.description: title of the existing entry to move

date.description: new day like 'friday' or 'day after tomorrow'

time.description: new time like '15:00'; empty keeps the current time

title.description: title of the entry to delete

date.description: optional day hint to pick the right entry
